description: This PHP class defines the model for NodeProgram, representing node program data within the application's data layer. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, saving, and validating NodeProgram instances, and interacts with database tables and related entities.

classes.name: NodeProgram
classes.description: Model class representing a node program, with properties mapping to database fields and methods for data management (fetching, listing, saving, validating).

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields that are language-dependent: title, description, action, action_url, modal_description.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a NodeProgram object by ID, including language-specific fields, throwing exception if not found.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a list of NodeProgram instances based on filters, pagination, and language context, or count of such items.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the current NodeProgram instance to the database, handling image headers appropriately.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the header image instance associated with the NodeProgram.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the NodeProgram data; currently, it checks if errors are empty.
